name: Item randomizer
author: Keros
description: Shuffles what the game gives out (Ratchet & Clank, and Going Commando): the gadgets and weapons from NPCs and pickups, the vendor's weapons, the gold bolts and the infobots' coordinates, so each seed is a new route through the game. Every seed can be finished: what you need is only ever placed where you can get it without it. Share a seed's code and a friend plays the same game. Each seed writes a spoiler log to the mod's data folder. A save made with a seed belongs to that seed.

settings.name: Seed
settings.description: A seed code to play a shared game (it carries its settings), or any word. Blank: a random seed, rolled once and kept for your next starts (the log and the spoiler log show its code).

settings.name: Logic
settings.description: Standard: what you need is never behind a very expensive purchase, and each place is expected to be done with the weapons the game suggests there. Relaxed: what you need also comes early in the game, and never behind a purchase you have to save up for. Expert: what you need may be behind any purchase, even the most expensive, and you get by with any weapon.

settings.name: Start in New Game+
settings.description: Ratchet & Clank: enable New Game+ and the Goodies menu for this randomized save. Does not grant gold weapons or completed-save inventory. Existing seed codes keep their item placement; this mode is selected separately.

settings.name: New games only
settings.description: Randomize only a game started with the item randomizer: a new game started from New Game with it on, or a save that game made (its save carries the seed's tag). A save from a game started without it, or with another seed, plays as the game does, so a playthrough is never changed partway. Off: such a save is randomized from where it is.

settings.name: Shuffle gadgets
settings.description: The gadgets NPCs and pickups give: the Swingshot, the Heli-Pack, the Magneboots, ... Going Commando: the Dynamo, the Swingshot, the Grindboots, Clank's packs, the Thermanator, the Glider, the Gravity Boots, ... Hoverboard, Bolt Grabber and Map-o-Matic are controlled by Shuffle items.

settings.name: Shuffle items
settings.description: RAC1: shuffle all nine Items-menu entries: Hoverboard, Persuader, Bolt Grabber, Map-o-Matic, Platinum Zoomerator, Raritanium, CodeBot, Premium Nanotech and Ultra Nanotech. When off they stay vanilla. Requires OpenRAC interface 1.16+.

settings.name: Shuffle weapons
settings.description: The weapons NPCs and pickups give: the Suck Cannon, the Morph-o-Ray, the R.Y.N.O. Going Commando: the Sheepinator.

settings.name: Shuffle the vendor
settings.description: Ratchet & Clank: each weapon the Gadgetron vendor sells is a slot that gives something else when bought, at the slot's price. Going Commando: each weapon the vendor sells comes on sale from another planet.

settings.name: Shuffle gold bolts
settings.description: Gold bolts join the pool: a gold bolt may be anywhere, and a gold bolt's place may hold a weapon or a useful extra, never something you need to go on.

settings.name: Shuffle infobots
settings.description: Ratchet & Clank: coordinates from pickups and NPCs join the pool. Existing seed codes keep their original settings.

settings.name: Show what the vendor gives
settings.description: A line above the picture says what buying a weapon at the vendor gives you. Off: buying is a surprise.

settings.name: Keep the starting gear
settings.description: Start with the Bomb Glove, as the game does. Off: what Veldin gives at the start is shuffled too.

settings.name: Shuffle gold-weapon cases
settings.description: Ratchet & Clank: shuffle the ten gold upgrades and their case rewards. Opens the Novalis shop without New Game+. Purchases keep bolt and Gold Bolt costs, without requiring the original base weapon. Requires OpenRAC mod-save support (interface 1.16).

settings.name: Spoiler log
settings.description: Write where everything is, and a way through, to the mod's data folder.

settings.name: Reward models
settings.description: Show randomized reward models, inventory icons and receiving animations at pickups and vendors. Off: use the original game presentation. Reload the mod after changing this option.

settings.name: Reward text
settings.description: Show randomized item names in NPC interaction prompts and supported vendor text. Off: use the original game text. Reload the mod after changing this option.
